High Performance Voxel Engine: Vertex Pooling - Nick's Blog
Even when a large amount of mesh and driver state is changing every frame (the entire scene), we can see that the vertex pool outperforms the naive implementation. Since the greedy meshing algorithm is identical, we observe that utilizing the vertex pool increases meshing speed due to other effects such as garbage collection and getting data to the GPU.
